title: Rethinking Back Transformation in 2-stage Eigenvalue Decomposition on Heterogeneous Architectures
problem: 2-stage EVD method loses performance advantage over 1-stage when computing eigenvectors via back transformation on GPUs.
motivation: Back transformation bottleneck limits applicability of efficient 2-stage EVD; need optimization for obtaining eigenvectors.
method: Replace BLAS3 with BLAS2 operations during bulge-chasing; reorder workflow from backward to parallelism-driven pattern hiding divide-and-conquer latency.
key_novelty: BLAS operation level optimization; parallelism-driven workflow pattern for back transformation.
contributions: 2.62x vs MAGMA and 2.21x vs cuSOLVER for complete FP64 EVD
